newIssues.title: Esc from the photo in pin mode drops keyboard focus to the page
newIssues.repro: Editor, Tab to "Pin a note" and press Enter; Shift+Tab ×5 to the photo region; press Esc.
newIssues.evidence: document.activeElement is <body> after the Esc (z3.cjs: "after Esc from frame: BODY", pin mode false). The same happens after Esc closes a thread whose focus had gone back to the photo region (h-focus.cjs step C, "after Esc (2) BODY"). Esc pressed on the pin toggle itself keeps focus there.
newIssues.fix: When pin / place / draw mode ends and focus is on the stage region that is about to lose its tabIndex/role, move focus to the tool that started the mode (the pin toggle; the Add-a-surface opener for place/draw) — e.g. in the mode-exit handler: if (frame.contains(document.activeElement)) pinToggle.focus({ preventScroll: true }).

newIssues.title: The Share dialog's WhatsApp draft keeps the editor's "2" ("your living room 2") while the client page says "your living room"

newIssues.evidence: Draft: "Hi Kevin, here is a design idea for your living room 2: …". The same link's page h1: "A design idea for your living room".
newIssues.fix: share-dialog.tsx line ~65: const plain = clientRoomNames(sharedRooms, rooms.map((r) => r.name)) — pass the design's room names as inDesign, as lib/visualizer/queries.ts and app/visualizer/actions.ts already do.

newIssues.title: "Vn is ready" / "Saved to Files" snackbars sit over the photo's bottom-left corner on wide stages
newIssues.repro: 1440: pick a light on the Original, Generate. 1024 touch: a version's ⋯ › Save to Files.
newIssues.evidence: 1440: snackbar x16–360 y775–823, photo frame x32–1036 y129–802 → 27px of the photo (floor) covered; the lift counts the canvas bar because the bar (x318–750) overlaps the snackbar band by 42px. 1024 touch: snackbar y547–595 vs photo bottom 560 (13px).
newIssues.fix: In the --bottom-dock measure, when the only thing the snackbar would cover is the bar's left 10–50px, rest it at the house place beside the bar instead of lifting over the photo; or include the photo frame in the check and prefer the lower position (over the grey canvas margin / strip head) whenever lifting would land on the photo.

newIssues.title: Remove the sofa: the rug laid under it is a paler, flat patch with a straight seam
newIssues.repro: Kevin Ng › Living room › Original › Furniture › Grey Fabric Sofa › Remove › Generate (also with Floor = Walnut vinyl plank in the same Generate).
newIssues.evidence: The rug's new part under the sofa is lighter and flatter than the real rug, with a hard vertical join where it meets it (≈ x685 of the 1004px crop), a straight left edge and a straight slanted top edge; the coffee table's left end reads sliced above it. Same result with Remove alone (V6) and Remove + walnut (V5). The engine report claims "no straight seam".
newIssues.fix: Blend the mended rug into the real rug with a feathered seam and match its luminance/scale to the rug's visible part (sample the patch nearer the join, histogram-match); alternatively stop the rug at its visible outline and lay floor where the sofa stood, which reads more natural than a pasted rug.

newIssues.title: Editor ghost: the rail foot is 28px taller than the page's on ≤800px-tall windows

newIssues.title: The lead's AI Visualizer quick link gives no feedback while it opens the design
